(Sửa 2026-08-11) Mã vụ việc — mã đoàn kiểm tra. Đổi nguồn từ Examination Team Target.Examination Team Code (lookup pair denormalized) sang join thẳng Examination Team.Examination Team Code, khớp SQL BA (alias a = EXAMINATION_TEAM, a.CODE)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date → examination_team.examination_team_code

description: Trạng thái — ETL-derived (Sửa 2026-10-01 theo BA STT 10): start = COALESCE(Start Date; kỳ kiểm tra từ ngày), end = COALESCE(End Date; kỳ kiểm tra đến ngày); cả 2 NULL→Chưa thực hiện; có start và (end NULL hoặc end > ngày ETL)→Đang thực hiện; có start và end ≤ ngày ETL→Đã hoàn thành. Giá trị phụ thuộc ngày ETL (sysdate trong SQL BA) — cần nạp lại hằng ngày
etl_logic: INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date → CASE WHEN COALESCE(examination_team.start_dt, examination_team.examination_period_from_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(examination_team.end_dt, examination_team.examination_period_to_dt) IS NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(examination_team.start_dt, examination_team.examination_period_from_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(examination_team.end_dt, examination_team.examination_period_to_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(examination_team.end_dt, examination_team.examination_period_to_dt) > :etl_date THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(examination_team.start_dt, examination_team.examination_period_from_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(examination_team.end_dt, examination_team.examination_period_to_dt) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(examination_team.end_dt, examination_team.examination_period_to_dt) <= :etl_date THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN COALESCE(examination_team.start_dt, examination_team.examination_period_from_dt) IS NULL AND COALESCE(examination_team.end_dt, examination_team.examination_period_to_dt) IS NULL THEN 'NOT_STARTED' END
